item.title: Bulletin updated at 08:55 HKT 15/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a very dry continental airstream, as well as sand and dust weather with weak winds, visibility will still be relatively low over Guangdong today and tomorrow. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large. A southerly airstream is expected to affect the coastal areas gradually in the following couple of days. The weather will be relatively humid over the region. A trough of low pressure will bring showers to Guangdong in the latter part of this week and early next week.
